title: Vehicle list + detail page with CPM expense editor
description: Create vehicle API client functions, Redux vehicle entity module, vehicle list page, vehicle create/edit FormDialog, and vehicle detail page with CPM expense editor. The expense editor allows adding/removing expense rows by category (FIXED, VARIABLE, SERVICE, WAGE, DEDUCTION) with key, label, and monthly amount fields. Auto-calculates: total monthly cost (sum of all expenses), cost per mile (total / monthlyMilesTarget), daily minimum revenue (monthlyGrossTarget / workingDaysPerMonth). CPM is calculated client-side, not stored (per L-007). Vehicle detail also shows ownership, emergency contact, warranty info.
acceptanceCriteria: Vehicle API functions in src/pages/fleet/api/vehicleApi.ts: getVehicles(params), getVehicle(id), createVehicle(data), updateVehicle(id, data, expenses?), deleteVehicle(id)
Redux vehicle entity module registered: entities.vehicles in rootReducer, vehicle sagas in rootSaga
VehicleListPage renders DataGrid with columns: unitNumber, year/make/model (combined), type badge, ownership (Owned/Leased), carrier name, licensePlate, isActive status, actions
VehicleListPage supports ?carrierId= filter, search (unitNumber, make, model), pagination

VehicleFormDialog uses Formik + Yup: unitNumber (required), type (required, EquipmentType select), carrierId (required), ownership (OWNED/LEASED), year, make, model, vin, licensePlate, licensePlateState, emergencyContactName, emergencyContactPhone, warrantyInfo, monthlyGrossTarget, monthlyMilesTarget, workingDaysPerMonth, notes
VehicleDetailPage shows: vehicle info card (unitNumber, type, ownership, year/make/model, VIN, license plate, carrier), emergency contact card (name, phone), warranty info
CPM Expense Editor section: table of expense rows grouped by category header, each row has: expenseKey (text), label (text), monthlyAmount (currency input); '+ Add Expense' button per category
Expense rows have Remove button; removing clears the row from the array

Auto-calculated summary displayed above expense table: Total Monthly Cost (sum), Cost Per Mile (total / monthlyMilesTarget), Daily Minimum Revenue (monthlyGrossTarget / workingDaysPerMonth) — all formatted as currency
CPM calculation updates in real-time as expenses are edited (client-side only, per L-007)
Save expenses via PATCH /api/v1/vehicles/:id with expenses array (replaces all rows)
Delete uses ConfirmDeleteDialog; shows blocking load list on 409
GIVEN vehicle with expenses totaling $8,500/month and 10,000 miles target THEN CPM displays $0.85/mile
contractReference: paths./vehicles, paths./vehicles/{vehicleId}, components/schemas/VehicleListItem, components/schemas/Vehicle, components/schemas/TruckExpense, components/schemas/TruckExpenseInput
validationCommand: npm run lint --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui && npm run check-ts --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui && npm run test --workspace=hussle-app-dispatch-ui
